description: Every employee action that changes data or touches an account is recorded in an application audit trail. This is application-level logging (logins, admin actions, data changes). It is not keystroke logging, screen capture, or activity surveillance. Each application keeps its own audit store, and the single SSO subject (sub) identifies the actor across all of them.

identity.source: Keycloak SSO subject of the ASAA realm
identity.rule: Every audit record stores the sub of the acting user. Shared accounts are not allowed.

retention.note: Keycloak admin events share the realm eventsExpiration in this Keycloak version, so the 90-day period applies to both login and admin events.

applications.forwardMechanism: asaa.event.v1 envelope POSTed to /api/v1/integration/events, with id as the idempotency key

mustAudit: export and GitHub or deployment actions
app launches and terminal or file changes

applications.store: admin audit log (src/lib/admin-audit.ts, append-only from the application view)
Keycloak events and admin events of realm asaa (identity/realm/asaa-realm.json)
mustAudit: admin create, update and delete on users, roles and clients
applications.forwardMechanism: Read locally by the owner. Forwarding to ASAA is pending a design decision.

eventEnvelope.schemaFileNote: Identical to the copy in the ASAA repository (verified by byte comparison on 2026-11-18).
eventEnvelope.rule: data must never carry secrets, credentials, tokens, raw personal data, or file contents. Maximum 16 KiB.
